architecture-review.json.review: Workbench retains strict interactive and inherited decoding; only common pure proposal restoration and result checks are shared. No new project reference, module dependency, registration, query, process, runtime partial or lock is introduced. The inherited codec has 11 source members and two private wire records in one cohesive validation/translation owner; retain it rather than split trivial stages. Two pre-existing codec/result size findings changed because their explicit common overloads were added. Existing one module cycle, five type cycles and 204 diagnostics remain unchanged and are not clean-solution evidence. Direct builds and selected runtime proof must be evaluated separately.

validation.cause: Nested ProcessStepInstanceId requires its existing explicit Workbench JSON converter; default deserialization changes its value. Canonical validation refuses it.

final-resource-reconciliation.json.outcome: Second codec run: 89 of 96 Unit cases pass; seven positive round trips expose another nested Process source canonicalization mismatch after background fields were repaired. The integration lane was not executed. Historical cleanup denials remain unchanged.
